scope: S074 binary-even cut grammar selected before formalization; finite controls alone carry zero proof credit.
main: C(w)=A0 with leftempty and finite right word w; w binary and has even1-count
forward_parser: After3steps from C(w), A reads w with leftwall32. Reading1·0^n·1 adds leftblock3·2^(n+1) and returnsA at remaining right word in n+2steps.
wall_merge: A0,left3·2^(a+1)·3·2·l,right r -> A0,left3·2^(a+1)·l,right11r in4a+8steps; arbitrary l,r.
wall_unwind: Finite wall blocks unwind to zeros(sum gaps)·101·1^(2k), preserving arbitrary rightcontext. Wall length decreases.
universal_return: Every binary-even C(w) has a positive finite return to another binary-even C(w'). Word length decreases during forward parse; wall length decreases during unwind.
entry: c0=C(empty), already binary-even; A recurs at cuts and B one step later.
